newsitem.title: UK: NWE high sulphur straight-run fuel supply grows.
newsitem.headline: NWE high sulphur straight-run fuel supply grows.

text.p: NWE high sulphur straight-run fuel oil supply appeared to lengthen on Tuesday with the emergence of three fresh E-4 cargoes, traders said.
One cargo was heard loading imminently, another on the vessel Blue Star on November 3-5, the third on November 6-8.
Offer levels were pegged at $4 over the three means of published quotes, while buyers were closer to +$2.50.
M-100 offers were heard at $3 over the mean of means of published quotes. -- Nicholas Shaxson, London newsroom +44 171 542 8167
